sentences.zh: 好了，现在准备好迎接一个小小的生日惊喜了吗？

sentences.zh: 好的，其实这是一首诗。

sentences.zh: 它只有六段，我一生中一直听过它的结尾，

sentences.zh: 但直到最近我才听过完整版。

sentences.zh: 作者是迪伦·托马斯。

sentences.en: It's called Do Not Go Gentle Into That Good Night.
sentences.zh: 诗名是《不要温和地走进那个良夜》。

sentences.en: It says,
sentences.zh: 它是这样写的：

sentences.en: Do not go gentle into that good night.
sentences.zh: 不要温和地走进那个良夜，

sentences.en: Old age should burn and rave at close of day.
sentences.zh: 老年应当在日暮时燃烧咆哮。

sentences.en: Rage, rage against the dying of the light.
sentences.zh: 愤怒吧，愤怒地抗拒那垂死的微光。

sentences.en: Though wise men at the end know dark is right,
sentences.zh: 尽管智者在临终时明白黑暗是必然，

sentences.en: because their words had forked no lightning,
sentences.zh: 因为他们的言语未能如闪电般劈开黑暗，

sentences.en: they do not go gentle into that good night.
sentences.zh: 他们绝不温顺地走进那良夜。

sentences.en: Good men, the last wave by,
sentences.zh: 善良的人，当最后一波浪潮涌过，

sentences.en: crying how bright their feral deeds have danced in a green bay.
sentences.zh: 呼喊着他们狂野的行径曾在绿湾中跳跃得多么灿烂。

sentences.en: Rage against the dying of the light.
sentences.zh: 愤怒地抗拒那垂死的微光。

sentences.en: Wild men who caught and sang in the sun in flight,
sentences.zh: 狂野的人，捕捉并歌唱着飞逝的太阳，

sentences.en: we learned too late, they grieved on its way.
sentences.zh: 我们太晚才明白，他们曾为它的离去而悲伤。

sentences.en: Do not go gentle into that good night.
sentences.zh: 不要温顺地走进那良夜。

sentences.en: Grave men near death, who see with blinding light,
sentences.zh: 严肃的人，临近死亡，以刺眼的光芒洞察，

sentences.en: blind eyes could blaze like meteors and gay.
sentences.zh: 失明的双眼也能像流星般燃烧、欢愉。

sentences.en: Rage against the dying of the light.
sentences.zh: 愤怒地抗拒那垂死的微光。

sentences.en: And you, my father, there in the sad height,
sentences.zh: 而你，我的父亲，在那悲伤的高处，

sentences.en: I very easily will fall in line with things.
sentences.zh: 我很容易就会顺从于事物。

sentences.en: But you strike me as somebody who knows exactly what they want out of life,
sentences.zh: 但你给我的感觉是，你非常清楚自己想要什么样的人生，

sentences.zh: 非常有主见，而且不害怕为了得到自己想要的而去改变生活中的事物。

sentences.zh: 我一直非常钦佩你这一点。

sentences.zh: 哦，我喜欢那首诗。

sentences.en: Well, yeah.
